import subprocess,json,time,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/private/tmp/hermes-production-release')
image='five-labs-reminder-api:production'
def run(*args):
 result=subprocess.run(['docker',*args],capture_output=True,text=True)
 if result.returncode: raise RuntimeError(result.stderr)
 return result.stdout.strip()
meta=json.loads(run('image','inspect',image))[0]
# Pin the tested artifact by immutable local image ID, even if the tag changes.
image_id=meta['Id']
name='hermes-production-release-smoke'
cid=run('create','--name',name,'--network','none',
 '-e','NODE_ENV=production','-e','NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=96 --import=/tmp/container-smoke-bootstrap.mjs',
 '-e','SUPABASE_URL=https://container-smoke.supabase.co','-e','SUPABASE_SECRET=synthetic-secret',
 '-e','KAPSO_API_KEY=synthetic','-e','OPENROUTER_API_KEY=synthetic',image_id)
try:
 run('cp',str(root/'bootstrap.mjs'),cid+':/tmp/container-smoke-bootstrap.mjs')
 run('start',cid)
 health=None
 for _ in range(40):
  probe=subprocess.run(['docker','exec','-e','NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=96',cid,'node','--input-type=module','-e',
   "import {get} from 'node:http'; get('http://127.0.0.1:3005/health',r=>{let b='';r.on('data',c=>b+=c);r.on('end',()=>{console.log(JSON.stringify({status:r.statusCode,body:b}));process.exit(r.statusCode===200?0:1);});}).on('error',()=>process.exit(1));"],capture_output=True,text=True)
  if probe.returncode==0:
   health=json.loads(probe.stdout.splitlines()[-1]);break
  time.sleep(.25)
 assert health and health['status']==200 and json.loads(health['body'])=={'status':'ok'},health
 audit=json.loads(run('exec','-e','NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=96',cid,'node','--input-type=module','-e',
  "import {readdirSync,readFileSync,existsSync} from 'node:fs';import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';function scan(d){return readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e=>e.isDirectory()?scan(d+'/'+e.name):[d+'/'+e.name]);}let files=scan('dist/runtime');console.log(JSON.stringify({node:process.versions.node,pid1:readFileSync('/proc/1/cmdline','utf8').split('\\0').filter(Boolean),sourcePresent:existsSync('src'),compilerPresent:existsSync('node_modules/typescript'),tsxPresent:existsSync('node_modules/tsx'),runtime:Object.fromEntries(files.map(f=>[f,createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(f)).digest('hex')]))}));"))
 assert audit['node'].startswith('22.')
 assert not audit['sourcePresent'] and not audit['compilerPresent'] and not audit['tsxPresent']
 local={str(p):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in Path('dist/runtime').rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
 assert audit['runtime']==local,'Image runtime differs from verified workspace build'
 before=json.loads(run('inspect',cid))[0]
 assert before['Config']['Cmd']==['node','dist/runtime/app/server.js']
 assert audit['pid1']==['node','dist/runtime/app/server.js'],audit['pid1']
 started=time.monotonic()
 run('kill','--signal','SIGTERM',cid)
 exit_code=int(run('wait',cid)); elapsed=time.monotonic()-started
 state=json.loads(run('inspect',cid))[0]['State']
 logs=run('logs',cid);(root/'container.log').write_text(logs+'\n')
 assert exit_code==0 and not state['OOMKilled'] and elapsed<25,state
 assert '"smokeExitCode":0' in logs
 result={'image':{'tag':image,'id':image_id,'created':meta['Created'],'repoDigests':meta.get('RepoDigests',[]),'platform':meta['Os']+'/'+meta['Architecture'],'user':meta['Config']['User'],'command':meta['Config']['Cmd']},'container':{'id':cid,'node':audit['node'],'nodeEnv':'production','originalImageCommand':True,'pid1Command':audit['pid1'],'health':health,'shutdown':{'signal':'SIGTERM','exitCode':exit_code,'elapsedSeconds':round(elapsed,3),'oomKilled':state['OOMKilled']},'network':'none','syntheticExternalDependencies':True,'runtimeBindMounted':False,'imageRuntimeMatchesWorkspace':True,'verifiedRuntimeArtifacts':len(local),'sourcePresent':False,'compilerPresent':False,'tsxPresent':False}}
 (root/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(result))
finally:
 (root/'container.log').write_text(run('logs',cid)+'\n')
 subprocess.run(['docker','rm','-f',cid],capture_output=True,check=True)
